text: === FILE src/judge/rules.ts === ⏎ import type { Judge, JudgeInput, Verdict } from "./types.js"; ⏎ export interface RulesJudgeOptions { ⏎ minChars?: number; ⏎ forbidden?: string[]; ⏎ } ⏎ export class RulesJudge implements Judge { ⏎ public readonly id = "rules"; ⏎ private readonly minChars: number; ⏎ private readonly forbidden: string[]; ⏎ constructor(opts: RulesJudgeOptions = {}) { ⏎ this.minChars = opts.minChars ?? 80; ⏎ this.forbidden = opts.forbidden ?? ["as an AI", "I cannot", "not found in the cited source"]; ⏎ } ⏎ async judge(input: JudgeInput): Promise<Verdict> { ⏎ const reasons: string[] = []; ⏎ let score = 0.5; ⏎ const deliverable = input.deliverables.join("\n"); ⏎ // Check minimum character count ⏎ if (deliverable.length < this.minChars) { ⏎ reasons.push(`Deliverable too short: ${deliverable.length} chars (minimum ${this.minChars})`); ⏎ return { pass: false, score: 0, reasons }; ⏎ } ⏎ // Check forbidden phrases ⏎ for (const phrase of this.forbidden) { ⏎ if (phrase === "not found in the cited source") { ⏎ // Special handling: only fails if it doesn't name a URL from the spec ⏎ if (deliverable.toLowerCase().includes(phrase.toLowerCase())) { ⏎ const specUrls = this.extractUrls(input.spec.ask + " " + input.spec.done); ⏎ const deliverableUrls = this.extractUrls(deliverable); ⏎ const namedSourceFromSpec = deliverableUrls.some((url) => specUrls.includes(url)); ⏎ if (!namedSourceFromSpec) { ⏎ reasons.push(`Forbidden phrase: "${phrase}" without naming the cited source`); ⏎ return { pass: false, score: 0, reasons }; ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ } else { ⏎ if (deliverable.toLowerCase().includes(phrase.toLowerCase())) { ⏎ reasons.push(`Forbidden phrase: "${phrase}"`); ⏎ return { pass: false, score: 0, reasons }; ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ // Check for quoted string + URL bonus ⏎ const hasQuote = /"[^"]+"|'[^']+'/.test(deliverable); ⏎ const specUrls = this.extractUrls(input.spec.ask + " " + input.spec.done); ⏎ const deliverableUrls = this.extractUrls(deliverable); ⏎ const quotesSourceFromSpec = deliverableUrls.some((url) => specUrls.includes(url)); ⏎ if (hasQuote && quotesSourceFromSpec) { ⏎ score = 1; ⏎ reasons.push("Bonus: quotes the source with a URL from the spec"); ⏎ } ⏎ return { pass: true, score, reasons }; ⏎ } ⏎ private extractUrls(text: string): string[] { ⏎ const urlPattern = /https?:\/\/[^\s)]+/g; ⏎ return text.match(urlPattern) || []; ⏎ } ⏎ }
